summary: Full-stack test of Rekan MVP (M0-M5). Backend: 13/13 pytest passed - health, seeded businesses/task cards, CRUD, publish validation (200/422), AI generate with fallback, AI simplify/translate, step-simplify caching, runs/stuck logging, insights aggregation (~40 runs, stuck cluster on step 4/7, first>latest, >=1 suggestions), demo payload with card+simpler+script. Frontend: landing role chooser, lang toggle (ID default), employer home + create business + generate-from-paste flow reached review page, ReviewEdit renders steps with readability badge & publish validation surfaces publish-errors when instruction >12 words, Worker at 375px advances 9 steps to finish-screen with 'Kamu menyelesaikan 9 langkah.', stuck-modal opens with simpler/picture/ask and simpler-text renders, Insights shows heatmap (step 4=15 highest, step 7=9 medium), median-time bars, 3 AI suggestions with apply links, impact strip. Demo auto-plays with 0 calls to /api/ai/*; toggle & restart work. All required data-testids present.
critical_code_review_comments: AI generate persists ai_fallback flag on the DB document but strips it via Pydantic model_dump on read paths — fine, just an implementation note.
publish_card raises HTTPException(422, {message, errors}) — FastAPI wraps this as {'detail': {...}}; frontend currently reads detail.errors correctly, keep aligned in any future refactor.
Backend files are small and focused; no >700-line files. Async usage is correct across routers.
Consider a real 404 body model with 'error' key for consistency; currently uses default {'detail': '...'} which is fine but not standardized.
seed_data_creation: Re-ran /app/backend/seed.py before tests: 3 businesses, 3 task cards, 40 runs, 25 stuck events, 3 suggestions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~10s (uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). If insights totals drift, re-run `cd /app/backend && python seed.py` (idempotent — deletes and re-inserts). Frontend all data-testids in review request are wired and working.
